column1: # The absent -> present -> present transcript the ensure driver must produce.
# AUTHORED from `substrate_doctrine.md` section 3: probe, install if absent, resolve
# the absolute path, invoke by it -- with the probe serving as the post-condition.
# The property is not "pass one looks like this". It is that **pass two and pass three
# carry probes and no mutation at all**. A driver that reported converged without
# re-probing produces a pass with no probe row; a driver that mutates on a converged
# host produces a pass with a mutation row. Both are seeded mutants, and each reddens
# `package-manager-root` issues no argv of its own: it is `verified-only`, an assertion
# that a floor member is present, which is not a command. It is therefore absent from
# the mutation rows and present in neither -- it is never installed.
# Paths are relative to the run-local fixture root, so this file compares against a run
# rather than against the temporary directory one run happened to use.
# A `converged` row records whether the pass reached the requested tool. It is
# recorded rather than fatal, so a pass that fails is attributed to the check it
# belongs to instead of taking every other replay check down with it.
